target_concept: Identify the three Git areas (working directory, staging area, repository) and explain how `git add` moves changes from the working directory to the staging area.

mcq.questionText: After executing the command `git add .`, which Git area contains the changes that were in the working directory?
mcq.explanation: `git add .` stages all modifications from the working directory, moving them into the staging area (also called the index) so they are ready to be committed to the repository.
